title: slack-notice notification (send --stdin-json, --file)
description: One notification. Unknown fields exit 20 invalid_payload. Text limits are applied after sanitizing by the tool; the bounds here only cap the raw input. Flag input (--title, --message, --level, --link) forms the same object.

title.description: Untrusted. One line (newlines become spaces); at most 256 characters after sanitizing.

message.description: Untrusted. At most 100000 characters of input; empty after sanitizing exits 20 empty_message.

link.description: Untrusted. An http or https URL with no whitespace or control characters and no userinfo. Another scheme exits 20 link_scheme; any other violation exits 20 link_invalid.
